problems.quote: the introduction of the 'Independent Director Databank', mandatory 'Board Evaluation' for listed entities
problems.problem: These were not introduced in 2022‑2023 amendments; the Independent Director Databank was launched in 2019 and mandatory Board Evaluation has been required under SEBI LODR since 2015.
problems.correction: enhanced requirements for the 'Independent Director Databank' and 'Board Evaluation' for listed entities
problems.verifierReason: Independent Director Databank launched Dec 2019; mandatory Board Evaluation under SEBI LODR 2015. 2022-23 amendments enhanced, not introduced, these.

problems.problem: Regulation 17(1A) of SEBI LODR deals with the requirement for an independent woman director, not with related party transactions or appointment of a promoter's relative. The relevant regulation for related party transactions is Regulation 23.
problems.verifierReason: Reg 17(1A) mandates independent woman director (top 1000 listed cos). Related party transactions governed by Reg 23.

problems.quote: rather than for use in production or supply of goods or services or for administrative purposes
problems.problem: The definition of investment property in Ind AS 40 includes two exclusion criteria: (a) use in production/supply/administrative purposes, and (b) sale in the ordinary course of business. The quote omits the second criterion.
problems.correction: rather than for use in production or supply of goods or services or for administrative purposes, or for sale in the ordinary course of business
problems.verifierReason: Original quote omits second exclusion criterion 'sale in ordinary course of business' per Ind AS 40 para 5. Correction accurately completes definition.

problems.quote: its reported revenue, profit or loss, or assets are 10 % or more of the combined revenue, profit or loss, or assets of all operating segments
problems.problem: The quantitative threshold for profit or loss is not 10% of combined profit or loss; it is 10% of the greater (in absolute amount) of the combined profit of all profitable segments and the combined loss of all loss-making segments.
problems.correction: its reported revenue is 10% or more of combined revenue, its profit or loss is 10% or more of the greater of combined profit or combined loss (absolute), and its assets are 10% or more of combined ass
problems.verifierReason: Original uses net combined profit/loss; Ind AS 108 para 13 requires 10% of greater of absolute combined profit or combined loss. Correction is accurate.

problems.quote: aluminium conductor with 1.6 times the diameter of a copper conductor offers comparable resistance
problems.problem: The diameter ratio for equal resistance is sqrt(ρ_Al/ρ_Cu) ≈ 1.28, not 1.6. 1.6 times diameter gives ~2.56 times cross-sectional area, resulting in higher resistance.
problems.correction: aluminium conductor with 1.28 times the diameter of a copper conductor offers comparable resistance
problems.verifierReason: Original diameter ratio 1.6 is too high; sqrt(ρAl/ρCu)≈1.28 is correct

problems.quote: decline in solar module prices from over $100/Watt in 2010 to under $0.20/Watt by 2020
problems.problem: Solar module prices in 2010 were approximately $1.5–2/W, not $100/W. $100/W reflects 1970s prices.
problems.correction: decline in solar module prices from over $1.50/Watt in 2010 to under $0.20/Watt by 2020
problems.verifierReason: 2010 module price ~ $1.5‑$2/W, not $100/W; correction reflects actual range

problems.quote: thermal power plants have high capital expenditure (CapEx) but low operational expenditure (OpEx), renewable sources like solar PV have inverted this ratio
problems.problem: Thermal plants have moderate CapEx and high OpEx (fuel); solar PV has high CapEx and low OpEx. The description of "inverted ratio" is reversed.
problems.correction: thermal power plants have moderate CapEx but high OpEx (fuel), while solar PV has high CapEx and low OpEx
problems.verifierReason: Thermal plants have moderate CapEx and high OpEx; solar PV high CapEx low OpEx – correction accurate

problems.quote: Rare Earth Free motor designs (e.g., Interior Permanent Magnet motors or Induction motors)
problems.problem: Interior Permanent Magnet (IPM) motors use rare-earth permanent magnets (e.g., NdFeB); they are not rare-earth free.
problems.correction: Rare Earth Free motor designs (e.g., Synchronous Reluctance motors or Induction motors)
problems.verifierReason: IPM motors use rare‑earth magnets; SRM and induction are rare‑earth‑free

problems.quote: Paper II of the Electrical Engineering optional covers three major domains: Power Systems, Control Systems, and Electronics
problems.problem: Power Systems and Control Systems are Paper I topics. Paper II covers Analog Electronics, Digital Electronics, Communication Systems, Power Electronics, Microprocessors, etc.
problems.correction: Paper II of the Electrical Engineering optional covers Analog Electronics, Digital Electronics, Communication Systems, Power Electronics, and Microprocessors
problems.verifierReason: UPSCEE Paper II covers electronics topics, not Power/Control Systems; correction lists proper subjects

problems.quote: virtually every work printed in England before 1700
problems.problem: EEBO covers works printed in England, Scotland, Ireland, Wales, and British North America, not only England.
problems.correction: virtually every work printed in the British Isles and British North America before 1700
problems.verifierReason: EEBO covers works printed in British Isles & British North America, not just England; correction accurately reflects scope.

problems.quote: the 1613 True Declaration of the Estate of the Colony in Virginia
problems.problem: The True Declaration of the Estate of the Colony in Virginia was published in 1610, not 1613.
problems.correction: the 1610 True Declaration of the Estate of the Colony in Virginia
problems.verifierReason: The document was issued in 1610, not 1613; correction to 1610 is accurate.

problems.quote: translated from Igbo oral tradition into English by Achebe himself
problems.problem: Things Fall Apart was written in English by Achebe; it is not a translation from Igbo.
problems.correction: written in English by Achebe, drawing on Igbo oral tradition
problems.verifierReason: Things Fall Apart was originally written in English by Achebe, though inspired by Igbo oral tradition; correction reflects this.

problems.quote: typically 10‑50 µs for a 10 kHz switching frequency
problems.problem: A 10 kHz switching frequency corresponds to a 100 µs period; the typical sampling period for MPC is equal to the switching period, not 10‑50 µs.
problems.correction: typically 100 µs for a 10 kHz switching frequency
problems.verifierReason: 10 kHz period is 100 µs; MPC sampling equals switching period. Original 10-50 µs incorrect.

problems.problem: A two-level three-phase VSC has 2^3 = 8 switching vectors (six active plus two zero vectors), not seven.
problems.verifierReason: 2-level 3-phase VSC has 2^3=8 switching states (6 active + 2 zero). Original 'seven' is wrong.
